quests.title: Cookfire Smoke

steps.objText: Follow the track toward the smoke
steps.journal: Cookfire smoke, so someone lives out here. Follow the track toward it.

quests.returnText: Tell Hesk you found the smoke

quests.title: Wolves at the Fence

steps.objText: Drive the wolves from the goose pen
steps.journal: A palisade, and wolves at its goose pen. Drive them off.

quests.returnText: Tell Hesk the wolves are gone

steps.objText: Speak to the woman at the gate
steps.journal: The wolves are gone, and the gate opens a crack. Tell Hesk who you are.

offer: Stop there. Hands where I can see them.
You came over the river. Nobody comes over the river.
Ferrum says we're dead. Who are you?
active: Well? A name. Or the river back the way you came.
ready: You tell her your name. She turns it over, slowly.
Wick.
We watched you at the fence. The wolves, too.
I'm Hesk. Come in, Wick. Keep your blade low.
Here. Ferrum's dead don't let a guest go cold.
done: Ferrum's dead are busy, Wick. Mind the geese.

quests.title: The Village Waystone

objectives.journal: The village waystone is dark. Part of it is missing. Ask Dorrin at the forge.

objectives.text: Take the brass off the barley gate
objectives.journal: Dorrin took the waystone's brass collar for a gate. Pull it off the barley gate.

objectives.text: Fit the collar to the village waystone
objectives.journal: You have the brass collar. Fit it to the village waystone and wake it.

quests.returnText: Fit the collar to the village waystone

offer: The old waystone in the yard. You came for it, I think.
We hear the call too. Nights. The stone here stays dark.
Something's missing from it. Ask Dorrin. At the forge.
He'll look at his boots. Let him. Then ask again.
active: Barley farm. East. Brass collar. Go on.
ready: The collar seats with a soft, sure click.
The bowl wakes teal and takes up the call.
done: Lit. Years, and it took a stranger and a gate.

quests.title: The Board of the Dead

objectives.text: Read the notices on the board
objectives.journal: The village waystone burns teal. In the plaza stands a board of names. Read it.

offer: The board by the gate. Read it. That's who we are.
active: The board by the gate. Read it. That's who we are.
ready: Crown notices, carried out past the Wall and nailed up.
FELL BEYOND THE WALL. HESK, OF THE TANNERS' STAIR.
FELL BEYOND THE WALL. DORRIN, FORGE HAND, LOW WARDS.
LOST TO THE HUSH. THE CROWN GRIEVES. SPEAK NO MORE.
Under each name, in charcoal: HERE.
One notice is cut. A strip gone, name and all, neatly.
Above the cut: FELL BEYOND THE WALL.
On the nail, a knot. A skyworks hitch, tied tight.
Your hands know it. You were taught it on the skyworks.
done: Pinned under the knot: a scrap of chart. Lines west.
You leave the knot where it is. The line runs west.

quests.returnText: Tell Hesk what the board says

quests.title: The Line West

steps.journal: The scrap's lines run west. Walk to the crossroads and look.

quests.returnText: Tell Hesk what the road looks like

quests.title: The Pulled Bridge

objectives.text: Read the stone north of the road
objectives.journal: A bridge once stood here. Only the piers are left. Read the stone north of the road.

offer: A tall stone by the track. Cut square, set on end.
Marks on one face. Too worn to read from here.
active: The stone by the track. Read it up close.
ready: The bridge stone. Aye. Pulled down, not washed out.
Not my work. Older than me. Here, arrows.
done: The stone stands. The river runs where the bridge was.

quests.returnText: Tell Dorrin what the stone says

quests.title: The West Arm

steps.objText: Find the sign arm in the shallows
steps.journal: The post sign has lost its west arm. Find it in the shallows.

quests.returnText: Bring the sign arm to the post-keeper

offer: My signpost lost its west arm in high water.
It's in the shallows somewhere. Find it for me?
active: The sign's west arm. Somewhere in the shallows.
ready: That's it. West points west again.
Arrows. For your wet sleeves.
done: West points west. As it should.

steps.objText: Drive three wolves from the goose pen
steps.journal: Wolves still circle the goose pen. Drive three of them off.

offer: Wolves still circle the goose pen.
Drive three off. I pay in arrows.
active: Three wolves. The goose pen. Go.
ready: Three gone. The geese can sleep.
Arrows, and a health potion. Fair pay.

steps.objText: Drive off two boars on the west bank
steps.journal: Boars raid the west bank. Drive two of them off.

offer: Two boars rooting on the west bank.
Drive them off. Mind the tusks.
active: Two boars. West bank. Mind the tusks.
ready: The bank's quiet. Good.
Take this. Old gear, but oiled.
done: A quiet bank. A quiet night. Rare out here.

steps.objText: Take the parcel to the forge
steps.journal: A parcel waits for the forge. Carry it there.

offer: This parcel goes to the forge. For the smith.
Don't open it. It's his.
active: The parcel. The smith, at the forge.
ready: About time. Don't ask what's in it.
Here. Hesk would want you paid.
done: He got it? Then he'll be up all night.

steps.objText: Cross the ford to the west bank
steps.journal: Nobody here has scouted the far bank in a while. Cross the ford to it.

offer: Nobody's looked at the far bank in a while.
Cross the ford. Look around. Come back.
active: Ford. Far bank. Look, then back here.
ready: Quiet over there? Good. Quiet is good.
Arrows. Don't lose them all at once.
done: Far bank's quiet. I'll sleep, then.

steps.objText: Fetch the sheaf at the barley gate
steps.journal: A sheaf is due from the barley gate. Fetch it.

offer: The barley gate owes us a sheaf.
Bring it here before the crows find it.
active: The sheaf. At the barley gate.
ready: A good sheaf. Bread for a week.
Arrows, and a health potion. For the carrying.
done: Bread tonight. Thank the barley, not me.

objectives.journal: Three targets stand along the track. Hit the first.
One target hit. Now the second.
Two hit. One target left on the track. Hit the third.

offer: Three targets stand along the track. Can you shoot?
Hit all three. I'll be counting.
active: Three targets, along the track. Hit them all.
ready: Three. I counted. You can shoot.
More arrows. Waste them on targets, not on us.
done: You shoot like you mean it. Good.

objectives.text: Hold the goose pen at night
objectives.journal: Wolves raid the goose pen by night. Wait there after dark, drive off the pack.

offer: The pack comes back after dark. For the geese.
Stand at the goose pen tonight. Drive them off.
active: After dark. The goose pen. Hold it.
ready: The pen held. You held. Thank you.
Two health potions, and arrows. Sleep now.
